---
title: "Question by question"
subtitle: "What happened to each research question in the three searches"
---

```{r}
source("_common.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
```

::: {.in-short}
**In short.** Each section below shows one question: what happened, the three exact searches,
the main numbers, and anything that went wrong. The sentences under *What happened* are
written automatically from the result files. The grey notes are written by hand (you can edit
them in `notes.csv`).
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Checkers: please stop here

This page shows which search found which records. If you are judging records or sentences for
the study, please come back after you have finished.
:::

```{r}
#| results: asis
lang_name <- c(en = "English", fi = "Finnish", sv = "Swedish")
for (q in qids) {
  qq <- questions[questions$id == q, ]
  mm <- metrics[metrics$question_id == q, ]; mm <- mm[match(conds, mm$condition), ]
  oo <- ov_A[ov_A$question_id == q, ]
  pl <- queries[queries$question_id == q, ]; pl <- pl[match(conds, pl$condition), ]
  aa <- annif[annif$question_id == q, ]
  um <- unmatched$anchor[unmatched$question_id == q]
  rq <- records_all[records_all$question_id == q, ]

  cat(sprintf("\n## %s {#%s}\n\n", qname(q), q))
  cat(sprintf("*%s*\n\n", esc(qq$question)))
  if (q %in% usable_q) cat(sprintf("[See the charts for this question](compare.qmd#compare-%s)\n\n", q))
  if (q %in% excluded$question_id) {
    cat(sprintf("::: {.callout-important}\n## Left out of the averages\n\n%s.\n:::\n\n",
                excluded$reason[excluded$question_id == q][1]))
  }
  cat(sprintf("Key words: **%s** | Years: %s | Asked in: %s\n\n", gsub(";", "** and **", qq$anchors),
              ifelse(is.na(qq$years) || qq$years == "", "none", qq$years),
              ifelse(qq$language %in% names(lang_name), lang_name[qq$language], qq$language)))

  # What happened (written from the numbers)
  b <- character()
  ia <- mm$index_matches[1]; ib <- mm$index_matches[2]; ic <- mm$index_matches[3]
  if (all(mm$records == 0)) {
    b <- c(b, sprintf("**No search found any records to keep** (matching records in Finna: A %s, B %s, C %s).", num(ia), num(ib), num(ic)))
  } else {
    if (ia > 0) b <- c(b, sprintf("Search C matched **%s** records in Finna, %s as many as search A (%s).", num(ic), times(ic / ia), num(ia)))
    else b <- c(b, sprintf("Search A matched **nothing**; search B matched %s and search C %s.", num(ib), num(ic)))
    jb <- oo$jaccard[oo$condition_b == "B_annif"]; jc <- oo$jaccard[oo$condition_b == "C_finto"]
    if (length(jb) && !is.na(jb) && jb == 1) b <- c(b, "Annif's words **did not change the result**: searches A and B kept exactly the same records.")
    else if (ib == ia && ia > 0 && mm$records[1] > 0) b <- c(b, "Annif's words did not change the number of matches, but changed which records came first.")
    sc <- oo$shared[oo$condition_b == "C_finto"]
    if (length(sc) && mm$records[1] > 0) b <- c(b, sprintf("Searches A and C have **%s of A's %s records** in common.", sc, mm$records[1]))
    kn <- mean(nzchar(rq$language))
    b <- c(b, sprintf("The language is known for %s of the kept records.", pct(kn)))
  }
  if (length(um)) b <- c(b, sprintf("No thesaurus concept was found for: %s, so search C could not add official names for %s.",
                                    paste0("*", um, "*", collapse = ", "), ifelse(length(um) > 1, "them", "it")))
  used <- aa$label[aa$used & tolower(aa$label) != tolower(aa$anchor)]
  if (length(used)) b <- c(b, sprintf("Annif's words added in search B: %s.", paste0("*", used, "*", collapse = ", ")))
  cat("**What happened**\n\n", paste0("- ", b, "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

  nt <- notes$note[notes$question_id == q]
  if (length(nt) && nzchar(nt)) cat(sprintf("\n::: {.callout-note appearance=\"simple\" icon=false}\n%s\n:::\n\n", nt))

  dg <- diagnostics_for(q)
  if (length(dg)) callout("warning", "Messages from the tool", paste0("- ", esc(dg)))

  # Numbers
  t <- data.frame(Search = cond_short,
                  `Search words` = mm$query_terms,
                  `Matching in Finna` = num(mm$index_matches),
                  `Kept (max 60)` = mm$records,
                  Institutions = mm$institutions,
                  `In common with A` = if (mm$records[1] == 0) rep("-", 3) else
                    c("-", ifelse(is.na(oo$jaccard[oo$condition_b == "B_annif"]), "-", pct(oo$jaccard[oo$condition_b == "B_annif"]))[1],
                      ifelse(is.na(oo$jaccard[oo$condition_b == "C_finto"]), "-", pct(oo$jaccard[oo$condition_b == "C_finto"]))[1]),
                  `Only through new words` = pct(mm$expansion_dependent_share),
                  check.names = FALSE)
  cat(paste(knitr::kable(t, row.names = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")

  # The three searches
  cat("**The three searches**\n\n")
  for (i in seq_along(conds)) {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="query" style="--c:%s"><strong>%s</strong>  %s</div>\n', cond_col[conds[i]],
                substr(cond_short[conds[i]], 1, 1), esc(pl$query[i])))
  }
  un <- aa$label[aa$mapping == "unanchored"]
  if (length(un)) cat(sprintf("\nAnnif's suggestions that did not fit the key words (not searched): %s.\n\n",
                              paste0("*", un, "*", collapse = ", ")))
  pp <- aa$label[aa$mapping %in% "partial_phrase"]
  if (length(pp)) cat(sprintf("\nAnnif's suggestions that are only part of a key word (not searched, because they would widen it): %s.\n\n",
                              paste0("*", pp, "*", collapse = ", ")))
}
```
